integrity: All mathematical proofs are internal to the result document or use explicitly credited classical labeled-tree enumeration. No independent audit or certification is asserted.
limitations: Ordinary zero forcing on triangular graphs J(n,2), n>=2, only. The minimum cardinality was known. No assertion is made for general J(n,k). Direct computations are finite checks, not proofs of the theorem. Related 2024 failed-forcing work was available in abstract only; equivalent unindexed results remain possible.
title: Zero-forcing sets of triangular graphs are complements of forests with an isolated vertex
